column1: # Silent read-catch ratchet baseline (docs/ci-guards.md#silent-read-catches). Enforced by
# around a read whose handler answers an empty value, per enclosing function. Rules and metrics: scripts/silent-read-rules.ts.
# capability_refusal_swallowed: a catch around a raw-SQL engine call whose handler can swallow a Rust capability refusal (scripts/capability-refusal-rule.ts).
# Generated from the tree at its own commit (`bun scripts/check-silent-read-catches.ts --print`); the note column names the audit
# finding (docs/research/gbrain-behavior-audit.md "The silent-failure class") that the fix for the row deletes.
# Counts only fall; a raise edits the row in the same PR with a note saying why. --prune lowers stale rows.
